items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: She was raised in my mother's house. She was raised in my mother's house. We were raised together.

ctx.x: Bessie Smith. Bessie Smith. Bessie Smith lived right next door to me.
She was raised in my mother's house. She was raised in my mother's house. We were raised together. Well, you know, Bessie made every record that I put out.
